actions.action: Track completion separately for every requested item
actions.mechanism: Calculate outstanding quantities from linked physical receipts, keeping supplier-confirmed quantities separate from delivered quantities.
actions.implementation: Add request-line IDs, requested quantity, confirmed quantity, received quantity, outstanding quantity, and item status to the existing spreadsheet or tracker.
actions.check: Request ten units; record confirmation of ten and deliveries of three and four. Show seven received, three outstanding.
actions.risk: Inconsistent quantity units can produce misleading balances.

actions.action: Give substitutions an independent named decision owner
actions.mechanism: A substitution remains unresolved until someone other than its requester records an explicit decision and rationale.
actions.implementation: Record original and replacement item IDs, quantity equivalence, requester, named approver, decision, rationale, and timestamp. Block requester approval.
actions.check: Attempt self-approval and verify rejection. Confirm another studio member can approve with rationale and preserve the original request.
actions.risk: Absent approvers can delay resolution; name an eligible backup.

actions.action: Prevent duplicate receipts from increasing delivered quantities
actions.mechanism: Stable receipt identifiers make repeated entry harmless; similarity checks flag duplicates entered under different identifiers.
actions.implementation: Key receipt lines by supplier, receipt number, and line number. Block repeated keys; flag matching item, quantity, and delivery-date combinations for review.
actions.check: Import the same receipt twice: totals must remain unchanged. A similar legitimate second delivery must be releasable after review.
actions.risk: Similarity alone cannot reliably distinguish duplicates from repeat deliveries.

actions.action: Separate excess delivery from request fulfillment
actions.mechanism: Keep physical quantities intact while identifying overages as unresolved exceptions rather than silently expanding the request.
actions.implementation: Show excess quantity separately, cap fulfilled quantity at the requested amount, and assign an existing teammate to record disposition of excess stock.
actions.check: Receive twelve against ten requested: show twelve received, ten fulfilled, two excess, zero outstanding, and an open exception.
actions.risk: Automatic closure would hide unresolved excess stock.

actions.action: Route ambiguous receipts through a matching inbox
actions.mechanism: Receipts without a reliable request-line match remain visible without prematurely satisfying any purchase request.
actions.implementation: Match using request reference and item ID. Send ambiguous matches or unapproved replacement items to an inbox with a named resolver.
actions.check: Create two open requests for the same item. An unreferenced receipt must not automatically complete either request.
actions.risk: Unresolved matching work can make genuine deliveries appear outstanding.

actions.action: Show the next action alongside completion
actions.mechanism: Separate quantity completion from unresolved decisions so fully delivered requests can still visibly need attention.
actions.implementation: Create a shared view showing outstanding lines, pending substitutions, unmatched receipts, overages, named action owners, and review dates. Close only when quantities and exceptions are resolved.
actions.check: A quantity-complete request with an unresolved overage stays open; a partial request identifies its outstanding item and next action.
actions.risk: Unmaintained owners and dates create a stale queue.

actions.action: Correct receipt mistakes without deleting history
actions.mechanism: Linked reversals and replacement entries preserve evidence while recalculating item balances and reopening affected requests.
actions.implementation: Protect posted receipt rows. Record corrections as signed quantity adjustments linked to the original entry, with author, timestamp, and reason.
actions.check: Correct a ten-unit receipt to six after closure. Verify six net received, four outstanding, reopened status, and retained history.
actions.risk: Unlinked adjustments can obscure which receipt was corrected.
